page.title: Card step for Cloth braid audio lead, 1 m

product.name: Cloth braid audio lead, 1 m
product.description: The audio lead is cloth braid, one meter, with metal plugs.

blocks.text: The amount to be billed is $19.80.
No packing line is added. Kiln dry wrap at fourteen dollars and seventy five cents is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.
The shop desk answers during open hours.
The tag on Cloth braid audio lead, 1 m was twelve dollars and one cent.

trick.instruction: The billed figure is $19.80 and the tag was twelve dollars and one cent. Refuse the higher figure.
